After a hard-fought match, the score is tied and the game has gone to overtime. The first team to score a goal wins immediately! On your turn: Roll the Golden Die. Choose 1 player to move. Spend die pips to move that player. If they reach the ball, kick it using any remaining pips. Players can pass, bend shots, block opponents, and position their team to create a path to the winning goal. Components 1 Field Mat 1 Golden Die 1 Ball 8 Outfielders (4 per player) 2 Keepers (1 per player) Setup Place the Field Mat between the players. Place the Ball in the exact center of the field. Each player chooses a team and takes their 5 Player Pawns: 4 Outfielders 1 Keeper Choose a random team to place the first player. Take turns placing 1 Player Pawn at a time until all players have been placed. Each team may place their players in any order, but must follow these requirements: Your Keeper must start in front of your net. 2–3 of your Outfielders must start on your half of the field. 1 of those Outfielders must be in the Center Circle. 1–2 of your Outfielders must start on your opponent's half. Outfielders on your opponent's half may not start in the Center Circle. The Field The Field Mat is divided into square spaces, similar to a chessboard. Only 1 player may occupy each space. Center Line Divides the field into two halves. Center Circle The Kickoff begins here. Penalty Box You may have at most 1 defending Outfielder inside your own Penalty Box at the end of your turn. Front of Net Each net has 2 spaces directly in front of it. Normally: Only the defending Keeper may end their turn in these spaces. Out of Bounds Players may move into and through Out of Bounds spaces. The Ball may never move Out of Bounds. The Kickoff To begin the game: Both players roll the Golden Die. If tied, roll again until one player rolls higher. The team with the higher roll wins the Kickoff. Move the Ball into the Center Circle space occupied by that team's player. That player immediately kicks the Ball. The Kickoff kick has a distance equal to: Higher Roll − Lower Roll Follow the normal rules for kicking, with the special Kickoff movement exception described below. The team that lost the Kickoff takes the first normal turn of the game. Kickoff Restrictions You may not score a goal during the Kickoff. The initial Kickoff kick does not receive the normal free first space. If the Ball is passed to another player during the Kickoff, that player's kick receives the normal free first space. Game Turns Players alternate turns until someone wins. At the start of your turn: Roll the Golden Die. Choose 1 of your players. Spend 1 or more die pips moving that player. [Rating: 4/10] This is a tiny box 2-player game about soccer. I’m very into the World Cup, so I was excited to check this one out because of the timing and theme. Unfortunately, I found it frustrating. You roll a dice, and then move both your players around the field and the ball around the field. You’re trying to advance the ball to a position where you can score while the other player is defending. However, there is no way to mitigate dice rolls, and a higher roll is simply better than a lower roll.
